description: The bar chart illustrates the effect sizes of various multilingual BERT models (mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, XLM-B₂) across four linguistic tags: 'case', 'gender', 'number', and 'tense'. The vertical axis, labeled 'effect', ranges from -5 to 20, with the horizontal axis displaying the four tags. For each tag, a group of six bars represents the different models, with colors corresponding to the legend: light blue for mBERT-L₂, dark blue for XLM-L₂, light green for mBERT-R₂, dark green for XLM-R₂, light red for mBERT-B₂, and dark red for XLM-B₂. Error bars indicate the variability of the effect estimates. In the 'case' category, mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ show the highest positive effects, with mBERT-B₂ reaching approximately 12.5 and XLM-B₂ around 11.5. In the 'gender' category, mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ again show the highest effects, both around 4.0. For 'number', the effects are generally lower, with mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ showing the highest values, around 3.0. In the 'tense' category, all models show very small effects, with mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ having the highest, around 1.0. The chart shows that the BERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ models consistently have the highest effect sizes across all tags, while the mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ models generally have the lowest.
